purpose: A single countable release-unit view: reconcile 9 bilingual draft dossiers to 8 contextual Calendar subjects. Neither creates a parallel Calendar nor publishes an unapproved ID.

gate_definitions.SOURCE_BOUNDED_EDITORIAL_REVIEW: Specific action, occasion and Catholic/institutional or historical sources agree within stated scope. Copy, local authority, canonical identity and actual Calendar publication are not approved.
gate_definitions.PARTIAL_SCOPE_EVIDENCE_HOLD: A related modern locality is confirmed, but the broad or original action still requires exact independent corroboration.
gate_definitions.EXISTING_OWNER_COMPONENT_REVIEW: Likely variant/contextual component of an existing canonical subject; do not create a duplicate ID.
gate_definitions.EXISTING_RESEARCH_OWNER_VARIANT_REVIEW: Relation to a previous accepted but unpublished research identity, exact scope not confirmed.

policy: This board is review data and contains no runtime or published data mutation. Do not treat a subject as an approved canonical custom or sanctioned ritual, and retain 1962 Calendar date authority.
